records.text: Planet Nine has five floors, two elevators, room for 16 guests, a 3,000-square-foot master apartment, a movie theater, a steam room, three libraries, and a jacuzzi.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Planet nine is five floors in total, but worry not because you're like, that's a lot of stairs. It has two elevators. It accommodates 16 guests. It has a master apartment that's 3000 square feet. It has a movie theater, a steam room, three libraries, a jacuzzi, you name it.

verification.notes: Current yacht references confirm five decks, two elevators, capacity for 16 guests in the cited configuration, an owner domain of about 3,229 square feet, a theater, steam room, jacuzzi, and beach club. The exact claim of three libraries was not substantiated, and current post-refit charter material lists 12 rather than 16 guests, so the full composite is only partly confirmed.

Current reporting identifies the 2021 host vessel as Nathaniel Rothschilds Planet Nine, while yacht-charter material describes its ice-class hull, certified helipad, steam room, jacuzzi, cinema, and heliskiing role.
